  update)
    if [ -z "${SHIFT_HOME:-}" ]; then
      tmp="$(mktemp)"; cp "$0" "$tmp"; SHIFT_HOME="$HERE" exec bash "$tmp" update; fi
    repo="$(sed -n 2p "$HERE/REPO.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"
    [ -d "$repo" ] || { echo "REPO.txt names no repository folder; run the installer by hand" >&2; exit 2; }
    git -C "$repo" pull --ff-only 2>&1 | tail -1
    machine="$(printf '%s' "$MACHINE" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')"
    if [ -n "$machine" ] && [ -f "$repo/machines/$machine/operator-config.json" ]; then
      MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 python "$repo/lighthouse/operator-kit/install.py" \
        --config "$(cygpath -w "$repo/machines/$machine/operator-config.json")" \
        --keep-from "$(cygpath -w "$HERE/config.json")" --out "$(cygpath -w "$HERE")" | tail -2
    else
      MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 python "$repo/lighthouse/operator-kit/install.py" \
        --config "$(cygpath -w "$HERE/config.json")" --out "$(cygpath -w "$HERE")" | tail -2
    fi
    mnt="$(cygpath -w "$HERE" | sed -e 's|\\|/|g' -e 's|^\([A-Za-z]\):|/mnt/\L\1|')"
    MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -d "$DISTRO" -- bash -c "mkdir -p '$WSL_HOME' && cp -r '$mnt/wsl/.' '$WSL_HOME/' && "\
"chmod +x '$WSL_HOME'/*.sh 2>/dev/null; echo 'WSL half refreshed at $WSL_HOME'" 2>/dev/null ||
      echo "the WSL copy failed; copy wsl/* into $WSL_HOME by hand"
    swap_new
    if outbox status | grep -q '^running'; then
      echo "outbox: $(outbox stop)"; echo "outbox: $(outbox start)"; outbox_alive; fi
    if steward status | grep -q '^running'; then echo "steward: $(steward stop)"; echo "steward: $(steward start)"; fi
    ;;
